purpose: Compare current Rabi-power implementation with primary 171Yb experiments without fitting an input to the target Rabi frequency.

source.title: Spectroscopy and Modeling of 171Yb Rydberg States for High-Fidelity Two-Qubit Gates
source.locator: Section V, printed pages 011009-9 and 011009-10; Appendix E1, Figure 18 on page 011009-23

reportedExperiment.upper: triplet-connected nu approximately 54.28, L=0, F=1/2, mF=-1/2
reportedExperiment.polarization: Linear perpendicular to magnetic field; half the total power drives sigma-
reportedExperiment.uncertaintyNote: Section V states working values without a joint power, waist and Rabi uncertainty budget. Unknown is not zero.

independentDipole.reason: No independently traceable numerical physical dipole for this exact state and experimental field has been adopted in the website catalog.
independentDipole.figure18: Contains state-specific calculated multipole matrix elements with F/mF dependence. Figure-generation values, fixed code version and operator normalization have not been closed; no graphical value is adopted as an exact input.
independentDipole.operatorBoundary: Equation A22 writes r^k Y_kq; the physical dipole convention must be reconciled before importing Q as e*r*C^1_q. Do not apply an extra CG factor to a fully resolved matrix element.

primaryCase.currentR2Reason: The saved R2 transition is n=65. A nu=54.28 F=1/2 state cannot use the n=65 dipole 0.0376 ea0 or an assumed n^-3/2 correction without an independently validated state map.

source.title: Absolute frequency measurement of the 1S0-3P0 transition of 171Yb
source.locator: arXiv v2 PDF page 4, Section II.E, clock interrogation and Figures 3-4

reportedExperiment.frequencyEvidence: Nominal Omega/(2*pi) derived as 1/(2*t_pi) from the stated experimental pi-pulse time; not a separately reported Rabi-oscillation fit.
reportedExperiment.spectrumLimitation: The paper attributes the typical 20 Hz linewidth to clock-laser frequency noise.

notEstablished: A matched independent direct fitted Rabi frequency and uncertainty
A complete motional and spatial averaging correction
A calibrated absolute Rabi uncertainty budget
A unique cause for disagreement with the beam-centre calculator

screenedNearMatches.reason: Clock Rabi approximately110 kHz and waist approximately20 um are reported, but90 mW is source SHG output before delivery losses, not a closed atom-plane power for that measurement.
Clock waists400x35 um and Rabi rates3-15 kHz are reported; a matching atom-plane clock power was not located.
5 mW belongs to the separate detuned sideband-cooling beam; carrier Rabi310 Hz is measured with the probe path. Those inputs must not be combined.
200 mW refers to generated UV source output;1 mW/40 um refers to the369.5 nm autoionization beam. Neither is a matched clock/Rydberg Rabi input.
Telecom excitation2.5 mW and approximately30 MHz are reported; the1389 nm waist is only described as several times larger than the35 um clock waist.
